convention_basis: EZ Tools present timestamps in UTC. Evidence in the inspected 2026.10 builds: help texts such as EvtxECmd '--sd Start date for including events (UTC)', MFTECmd '--cutoff ... (UTC unless an offset is given)' and the ISO format string 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffffffZ'. Not yet confirmed against real output on Windows; values are therefore labelled 'tool UTC convention', not 'explicit UTC'.

events.meaning: ShellBag registry key last written (not necessarily a folder visit)
First interaction time derived by SBECmd
Last interaction time derived by SBECmd
Folder created (as recorded in the shell item)
Folder modified (as recorded in the shell item)
Folder accessed (as recorded in the shell item)

column_verification: Column names confirmed as property identifiers in SBECmd.dll 2026.10.2 (static); a real CSV header from this build has not been observed on the build host.
